answer.sql:
SELECT TOP 10 ITEMS.[NAME] AS kitap, SUM(STLINE.[LINENET]) AS satis_tutar
FROM (SELECT '211' AS [__nb_firm], [CANCELLED], [DATE_], [LINENET], [LINETYPE], [STOCKREF], [TRCODE] FROM [dbo].[LG_211_01_STLINE] UNION ALL SELECT '411' AS [__nb_firm], [CANCELLED], [DATE_], [LINENET], [LINETYPE], [STOCKREF], [TRCODE] FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_STLINE]) AS STLINE
JOIN (SELECT '211' AS [__nb_firm], [LOGICALREF], [NAME] FROM [dbo].[LG_211_ITEMS] UNION ALL SELECT '411' AS [__nb_firm], [LOGICALREF], [NAME] FROM [dbo].[LG_411_ITEMS]) AS ITEMS ON STLINE.[STOCKREF] = ITEMS.[LOGICALREF] AND STLINE.[__nb_firm] = ITEMS.[__nb_firm]
WHERE STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[LINETYPE] = 0
  AND STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND STLINE.[DATE_] < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS.[NAME]
ORDER BY satis_tutar DESC
